title: Xila developer key (experimental v1)
description: A developer (publisher) key file, keys/developers/<id>.json in xila-project/registry. The key signs package manifests; it is not a trust anchor and may only publish packages whose first identifier label is in namespaces.

$schema.description: Optional editor-facing schema URL; not a trust anchor.

id.description: Identifier referenced by registry entries (publisher); must equal the file name.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key in canonical base64.

openssh.description: The same key in OpenSSH form; informational only.

namespaces.description: First labels of package identifiers this key may publish, e.g. xila for xila.clock.
